method_commitments: Implement Latent Ewald Summation (LES): equivariant network predicts latent charges z_i from structure.
Long-range electrostatics via Ewald summation on z_i without explicit charge equilibration.
Short-range potential learns residual after LES.
Baselines: short-range only, separate models per charge state (ag3).
Reproduce paper figs: Fig1 charge recovery, Fig3 dimer binding, Fig5e/Table1 Ag3 PES/charges.
